answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat block fake identities. Each agent posts a bond. Hourly, a beacon picks agents to prove work in ten minutes with an unshareable kernel task. Like a cedar adding rings, trust comes from heartbeats over 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 checks at 20 units, 20,000 units, plus lost bonds. A relic identity that stops proving work loses its slot. An honest agent pays once for undiluted rewards.
